content.title: How to Celebrate Hanuman Jayanti at Home
content.html:
1. Fasting (Vrata) Rules

Many devotees observe a complete or partial fast (Vrat) on Hanuman Jayanti. The fast begins at sunrise and is broken in the evening after offering prayers to Lord Hanuman. During the fast, take only fruits, milk, and water. Maintain complete celibacy (Brahmacharya).

2. Puja Setup & Offering

Decorate Lord Hanuman's photo with red flowers and marigold garlands. Apply orange sindoor mixed with sesame oil to the idol or photo. Offer red Boondi, Besan Ladoo, bananas, and sweet leaves (Paan) as prasadam.

Recite the Hanuman Chalisa 11 times or chant the Bajrang Baan to seek protection and blessing.

faqs.question: When is Hanuman Jayanti celebrated?
faqs.answer: In North India, Hanuman Jayanti is celebrated on Chaitra Purnima (full moon day of Chaitra month). In South Indian traditions (such as Andhra Pradesh and Telangana), Hanuman Jayanti is celebrated on Krishna Paksha Dashami of Vaishakha month.

faqs.question: What is the best time to do Hanuman Jayanti Puja?
faqs.answer: Because Lord Hanuman was born at the hour of sunrise, the Brahma Muhurat (around 06:05 AM to 08:32 AM) is considered the most auspicious window for chanting and performing puja.

faqs.question: What offerings are dear to Lord Hanuman?
faqs.answer: Sindoor mixed with jasmine/sesame oil (Chola), red flowers, bananas, motichoor or besan ladoos, and sweet betel leaf (meetha paan) are revered offerings.
